summary: ACE cable row guidance uses a stable seated position, neutral spine and controlled scapular/shoulder retraction; rear-delt emphasis changes elbow path rather than support demands.

title: Shoulder Scaption
summary: ACE scaption uses a stable standing base and controlled arm elevation in the scapular plane, emphasizing posture and shoulder control.

title: Dead Bug
summary: NASM describes dead bug as an accessible all-levels supine core-stability exercise with controlled contralateral arm/leg motion while maintaining trunk position.

title: Triceps Dip
summary: ACE parallel-bar triceps dip requires supporting full bodyweight through the arms, controlled elbow/shoulder flexion and stable suspended body position.

title: Bodyweight Squat
summary: ACE squat guidance requires controlled bilateral stance and alignment through hip/knee flexion; a sustained deep position increases positional control demand but does not add external load.

title: Lunge Variations
summary: ACE lunge progressions emphasize single-leg stability, controlled stepping/lowering and mastery of bodyweight patterns before added resistance; cross-behind direction increases multiplanar control.
